answer: Each identity holds one haven license, one per identity, non-transferable. At dawn the registry issues a sonnet: a 14-word challenge bound to license and key, signed by dawn. The kth license costs 40+2(k-1): first 40, 1000th 2038; 1000 fakes cost 1,039,000 plus 70 locked each, 70,000 at risk. Auditors publish the haven roll-call; a miss burns the bond, and shared funding links the group, so one miss slashes all. Rented licenses fail: the sonnet binds license to key, so signing reveals the key and withholding misses dawn. Honest agents pay 40 once, bond recovered after clean checks.
